plan.title: School Infrastructure and Enrolment
plan.subtitle: Tracking school enrolment trends and infrastructure gaps for girls and boys.

panels.title: School Enrolment Trend
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM(Girls 2022) AS girls_2022 FROM school_enrolment_by_year WHERE School Name IN (SELECT School Name FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY School Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, SUM(Girls 2023) AS girls_2023 FROM school_enrolment_by_year WHERE School Name IN (SELECT School Name FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY School Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(Girls 2024) AS girls_2024 FROM school_enrolment_by_year WHERE School Name IN (SELECT School Name FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY School Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps
panels.sql: SELECT School Name, 'Toilets functional (girls)' AS infrastructure_item, SUM(CASE WHEN Toilets functional (girls) = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM school_infrastructure GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps - Water & Electricity
panels.sql: SELECT School Name, 'Drinking water' AS infrastructure_item, SUM(CASE WHEN Drinking water = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM school_infrastructure GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Top 10 Schools by Enrolment
panels.sql: SELECT School Name, SUM(Girls 2024) AS total_enrolment FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: School enrolment has shown a steady increase from 2022 to 2024, with {{p1.girls_2022}} students enrolled in 2022, {{p1.girls_2023}} in 2023, and {{p1.girls_2024}} in 2024.  There are infrastructure gaps in several schools, particularly regarding toilet facilities for girls.  {{p2.count}} schools lack functional toilets for girls.  Similarly, access to drinking water is also a concern for {{p3.count}} schools.  The top 10 schools with the highest enrolment are listed in the table.
